items.title: Michael Burry Is Betting a Buyer Will Pay Up to $120 a Share for Fiserv
items.summary: Michael Burry says a buyer could pay $100 to $120 a share for Fiserv. For a 68-year-old who bought 1,000 shares at $120 in 2023 and now holds $62,880, the top of that range is break-even. Here is what Burry's range, Wall Street's $61 target and the tax loss on a sale each mean in dollars, and the case for selling half.

items.title: What Global Payments (GPN) Earnings Beat Means For Shareholders
items.summary: Global Payments reported third quarter 2026 results with US$3.31b in revenue, adjusted EPS of US$3.58, a higher Worldpay expense synergy target of US$650 million and a confirmed US$0.25 dividend, while management dismissed private equity buyout rumors. New multi year Genius platform and merchant services agreements with the University of Memphis and NASCAR highlight Global Payments’ push into stadium and venue payments.
